GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.3 (10 Nov 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 263)
A. P. O. 500
10 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Provision of Coal at Kyushu Ports for British Government.
1. It is directed that necessary action be taken at once to institute measures that will insure monthly delivery to British controlled ships at Kyushu ports of 18,000 tons of coal. Coal will be consigned to Conmanderin-Chief, British Grown Colony of Hong Kong.
2. The initial delivery will be made alongside the S. S. "FORT BUFFALO", approximately 8,000 tons, which is now at Sasebo to accept delivery.
3. You will maintain an accurate account of the deliveries of coal to the British under this order and will advise this Headquarters as soon as practicable after each delivery of the quantity lifted. Quantitative receipts should be obtained for each delivery from the Master of the ship, the original being retained in your records and a copy attached to your report made to this Headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
